name: Irkutsk
source:
A dramatization of the relationship between Nikita Lytkin and Artyom Anoufriev as well as a of their crimes between 2010-2011. 

This is a mere interpretation of their relationship and case through an artistic lense, being an extremely dramatized depiction of facts and fiction. Do not take it as an accurate reconstruction.
translation:
本作是对尼基塔·雷特金与阿尔乔姆·阿努夫里耶夫之间的关系，以及两人在2010—2011年间所犯下罪行的戏剧化改编。

本作仅是从艺术视角对两人关系与案件所做的个人诠释，将真实事件与虚构创作进行了高度戏剧化的加工演绎，请勿将其视作对史实的准确还原。
